concepts.content: Now, there is another way to write the same code using the for each loop. Here we type for, in parentheses we declare a loop variable, but the type of this variable should be based on the type of items in our array. So here we have a string array and that means every item in this array is a string. So here we should declare a string variable, we call it fruit here we type a colon and then the name of our array fruits. Now in each iteration, fruit will hold the value of one item in this array. So here we don't have to declare a numeric counter, we don't have to write a boolean expression like this, we don't have to increment our counter, it's much easier to iterate over an array. Now, if we print fruit, we get the exact same result as before.
